text: Glow Aesthetics Med-Spa is at 12 Rosenstrasse, Berlin 10178, second floor. Free client parking is available in the courtyard; the entrance is from Rosenstrasse. The nearest U-Bahn station is Alexanderplatz (5 minutes on foot).
We are open Monday to Wednesday and Friday 10:00-19:00, Thursday 10:00-20:00, Saturday 10:00-16:00, and closed on Sunday and public holidays.

Botox (botulinum toxin) treatment takes about 30 minutes and costs $350 per area. Results appear within 3-7 days and last 3-4 months. Before your visit: avoid alcohol for 24 hours. Tell us about any blood thinners, supplements or medication you take — your practitioner will advise what to pause and when. After: do not rub the treated area, lie down or exercise for 4 hours.

Dermal filler (hyaluronic acid) takes about 45 minutes and costs $550 per syringe. A $100 deposit is required when booking. Mild swelling and bruising for 2-3 days is normal. Avoid makeup for 12 hours and intense heat (sauna, sunbeds) for 48 hours.
HydraFacial is a 60-minute deep-cleansing, exfoliation and hydration facial for $200. There is no downtime; you can return to normal activities immediately. We recommend a treatment every 4-6 weeks.

Laser hair removal for a small area (upper lip, chin, underarms) takes 30 minutes and costs $120 per session. Shave the area 24 hours before; do not wax or pluck for 4 weeks before. Avoid sun exposure and self-tanner for 2 weeks before and after. Most clients need 6-8 sessions, 4-6 weeks apart.
A chemical peel takes 45 minutes and costs $180. Expect mild redness and flaking for 3-5 days. Stop retinol products 5 days before. Use SPF 50 daily for two weeks after.

Microneedling takes 60 minutes and costs $300. Redness similar to a sunburn lasts 24-48 hours. Avoid makeup for 24 hours and sun exposure for one week. A series of 3 sessions, 4 weeks apart, is typical.

We do not perform injectable treatments (Botox, filler) during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or if you have an active skin infection in the treatment area. If you take blood thinners, have a neuromuscular condition, or have had an allergic reaction to a cosmetic injectable, please tell us before booking so a practitioner can review your case.

Every new client completes a short medical intake and consent form before the first treatment. We send a secure link when your first appointment is booked; it takes about 5 minutes. Please bring a photo ID. Arrive 10 minutes early.

You can reschedule or cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before your appointment. Cancellations less than 24 hours before the appointment, and no-shows, are recorded and may require a deposit for future bookings. If you are more than 15 minutes late we may need to shorten or reschedule the treatment.
We accept cash, Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Apple Pay and Google Pay. Payment is taken at the clinic after the treatment, except deposits, which are taken at booking.
Clients must be 18 or older for injectable treatments and laser hair removal. Facials and peels are available from 16 with a parent or guardian present.

A team member is available during opening hours at +49 30 000 0000 or hello@glow-aesthetics.example. Outside opening hours, leave a message with the assistant and we will call you back on the next working day.
